title: cnvkit-pon pipeline parameters
description: Build a CNVkit panel-of-normals reference.cnn from a pool of normal CRAMs

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define the input files and where results are written.

input.description: Path to samplesheet CSV. Three columns, no header: sample_id, cram_path, crai_path.
input.help_text:
Each row is one normal sample. Example:
  NA12878,/data/NA12878.cram,/data/NA12878.cram.crai

fasta.description: Path to reference genome FASTA. Must match the build used to align the input CRAMs.

fasta_fai.description: Path to FASTA index (.fai). Auto-detected as <fasta>.fai if not supplied.

targets.description: Capture BED file for the exome or panel kit. Must match the kit used in your Sarek run.

outdir.description: Directory where results will be published.

cnvkit_options.title: CNVkit options
cnvkit_options.description: Parameters controlling CNVkit binning and coverage calculation.

access.description: Pre-computed accessible-genome BED (output of cnvkit.py access). Generated automatically if not supplied.

annotate.description: Gene annotation file (refFlat or similar) for labelling target bins.

short_names.description: Shorten long region names in target and antitarget BEDs.

target_avg_size.description: Average target bin size in bp passed to cnvkit.py autobin. 267 is the CNVkit recommended default for WES.

antitarget_avg_size.description: Average antitarget (off-target) bin size in bp.

min_mapq.description: Minimum MAPQ for reads counted by cnvkit.py coverage. Set to 20 to exclude multi-mappers.

count_reads.description: Use read-count depth instead of average depth per base in coverage calculation.
